test_description: Active decoder config read — write 9 Q7.8 weights to shadow bank, verify active bank unchanged before commit, commit, and verify exact readback + out-of-range index safety
input_contract: 9 signed 16-bit Q7.8 LLR weights in shadow/active register banks

expected.active_readback: Shadow isolated prior to commit; exact 9-weight active readback after commit; OOB index -> 0

actual.active_readback: All 9 weights verified before/after commit; swap_count=2; OOB(-1,9)=0
